{{Top|leg}}
'''H'gartha''' was a liquid [[Neurotoxin/Legends|neurotoxin]] used by the [[Malkite Poisoners]]. It was virtually undetectable by medical [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], and single vial had enough [[Poison/Legends|poison]] to kill an individual. H'gartha had no known antidote, and only immediate immersion in [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] could save the afflicted. However, once the individual was removed from bacta, the poison took hold once more.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
